main.title: US judge approves Bayer's $7.25 billion cancer settlement
main.summary: Bayer could end years of costly lawsuits in the US over claims that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer. Tens of thousands of people could now receive compensation, although some lawyers say the payments are too low.

related.title: Bayer’s $7.25bn settlement over cancer cases approved by US judge
related.summary: Ruling will help German chemicals group contain legal bills after years of court battles

related.title: Judge Approves $7 Billion Settlement Over Claims That Roundup Caused Cancer
related.summary: The ruling, in a nationwide class-action suit, is expected to end tens of thousands of lawsuits by people claiming that Roundup caused non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

related.title: Giudice Usa, 'la Bayer pagherà 7,25 miliardi alle vittime del diserbante Roundup'
related.summary: E' uno dei più grandi risarcimenti collettivi della storia americana

0731596bea.topic: Bayer, giudice USA approva maxi-risarcimento da 7,25 miliardi per il Roundup
0731596bea.reason: È una notizia nuova e ripresa da quattro testate autorevoli: per un grande gruppo europeo chiude anni di cause sul diserbante, ed è uno dei risarcimenti collettivi più grandi della storia americana.

main.title: Russian projectiles hit Poland as NATO tensions rise
main.summary: Three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. A suspected jet-powered drone and a missile struck separate locations near the Ukrainian border, while another missile crashed just 35 kilometres from an area where European troops are taking part in military exercises. Meanwhile, troops from eight NATO countries are conducting drills in neighbouring Lithuania. With US-led peace talks yet to make a breakthrough,

related.title: Russian missiles hit Poland: What happened, and could NATO respond?
related.summary: Warsaw accuses Moscow of intentional provocation, but bar for triggering NATO's collective defence clause remains high.

123159c184.topic: Proiettili russi colpiscono la Polonia, la NATO condanna
123159c184.reason: Un drone e un missile russi sono caduti su un Paese NATO: la NATO condanna, Varsavia parla di provocazione intenzionale. È un'escalation diretta che riguarda la sicurezza europea e l'Articolo 5.
